faces.name: Tibalt's Rager
faces.oracleText:
When this creature dies, it deals 1 damage to any target.
{1}{R}: This creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.

faces.name: Tibalt's Trickery
faces.oracleText: Counter target spell. Choose 1, 2, or 3 at random. Its controller mills that many cards, then exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile a nonland card with a different name than that spell. They may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Then they put the exiled cards on the bottom of their library in a random order.

faces.oracleText:

−X: Create X 1/1 red Devil creature tokens with "When this creature dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
